dimensions: Damage the fighter can withstand without recovery.
How long the fighter can sustain their effort.
Tools and weapons available in this profile.
Ability to threaten and control distance.
Healing, repair, or regeneration during combat.
Composure and willingness to continue under pressure.
stages: Daylight, flat terrain, and unobstructed lines of sight.
Buildings break sight lines and provide cover and vertical routes.
Canopy, obstacles, and short engagement distances.
A shoreline with dry ground, shallow water, and surf.
An indoor ruin with limited flight space and tight corners.
Elevated platforms with gaps and open air.

open: Open sight lines support attacks from the air.
coast: Flight can bypass the shore break.
inland: Ceilings and walls obstruct aerial movement.
sky: Flight reduces the cost of crossing open gaps.

open: Unbroken sight lines support ranged attacks.
urban: Buildings provide cover and elevated positions.
coast: The shoreline leaves longer sight lines.
sky: Open gaps create wide firing lanes.

open: Little cover on the approach to close range.
coast: Surf and wet footing slow ground movement.
sky: Ground approaches are interrupted by gaps.

urban: Structures create routes and flanking options.

inland: There is little usable water inside.
sky: The arena offers little water access.

open: The flat arena provides few positional tools.
inland: Corners and chokepoints create positional advantages.

coast: Open shoreline helps cover multiple approaches.

urban: Corners and cover create ambush opportunities.
inland: Dark corners and short sight lines help concealment.
sky: Gaps and exposed platforms reduce approach routes.

roster.name: Son Goku
roster.version: Dragon Ball Super manga · Ultra Instinct
roster.note: Ultra Instinct improves reactions, but its sustained use is taxing. Use manga Super feats and exclude Heroes.

roster.name: Superman
roster.note: Solar-powered flight, physical strength, and heat vision are staples. Kryptonite and red sunlight are deliberate conditions rather than baseline gear.

roster.name: Naruto Uzumaki
roster.version: Fourth War · Six Paths Sage Mode
roster.note: Shadow clones support misdirection and mass attacks. Kurama and Six Paths abilities belong to this listed form.

roster.name: Ichigo Kurosaki
roster.note: Getsuga techniques give ranged options beyond the sword. The manga shows limited operating time for true Bankai.

roster.name: Roronoa Zoro
roster.note: Three-sword style and Haki make a high-output swordsman. His ability to keep fighting through injury is stamina rather than regeneration.

roster.name: Erza Scarlet
roster.note: Requip offers different armor and weapons midfight. This profile uses her own late-series kit.

roster.name: Sasuke Uchiha
roster.note: Position switching, genjutsu and Susanoo give varied tools. Cross-universe genjutsu effectiveness remains an assumption.

roster.name: Hiei
roster.note: The Dragon of the Darkness Flame gives powerful area attacks, alongside fast sword work.

roster.name: Shigeo Kageyama
roster.note: Psychic barriers and telekinesis matter more than his physical build. Uncontrolled peaks are difficult to sustain.

roster.name: Tatsumaki
roster.note: Large-scale psychic control and barriers can dominate terrain. Reserve and injury still limit extended output.

roster.name: Aang
roster.note: The original series finale demonstrates all four elements and energybending. Water access and room to maneuver affect options.

coast: Open shoreline provides potential cover for regrouping behind water barriers.

roster.name: Edward Elric
roster.note: Clap transmutation and automail provide fast improvisation. A Philosopher’s Stone or outside sacrifices are excluded.

inland: Stone and metal surfaces provide material for transmutation.

roster.name: Jotaro Kujo
roster.note: Star Platinum's speed and brief time stop are distinct from Jotaro's physical endurance. Cross-world Stand visibility is uncertain.

roster.name: Kenshiro
roster.note: Hokuto Shinken pressure points work exceptionally well against compatible bodies. Applicability to unfamiliar species is uncertain.

roster.name: Kirby
roster.version: Mainline Nintendo games · normal starting kit
roster.note: Inhale and copy abilities create matchup-specific options. Temporary gear is limited to the conditions under which Kirby acquires it.

roster.name: Majin Buu
roster.note: Regeneration can outlast many threats. Complete destruction remains a relevant defeat condition.

roster.name: Ryu
roster.note: Experienced martial artist with Hadoken. Evil Ryu and crossover-only feats are outside this version.

roster.name: Jin Kazama
roster.note: Devil powers add lasers and flight to a strong close-range toolkit. The selectable Devil form is used consistently.

roster.name: Sephiroth
roster.note: Masamune and magic are central. Combat animation scale and Jenova-related effects are interpreted conservatively.

roster.name: Vergil
roster.note: Yamato, summoned swords and Devil Trigger provide varied pressure. Spatial cuts are a mechanic, with cross-world outcomes uncertain.

roster.name: Dante
roster.note: Devil Trigger and a wide weapon kit let him adapt at close and medium range. Ratings use the DMC5 form.

roster.name: Bayonetta
roster.note: Witch Time and summons change tempo. Dodges and summon availability depend on the situation.

roster.name: Satoru Gojo
roster.note: Infinity, Unlimited Void and reverse cursed technique carry distinct mechanics. Defeating Infinity requires a credible interaction.

roster.name: Makima
roster.version: Part 1 · contracts active, no new allies
roster.note: Control and contract-based survival matter greatly. Both are conditional and depend on how the opponent's attack is defined.

roster.name: Frieza
roster.note: Golden form has extreme range and power. The baseline excludes later manga forms.

roster.name: Megatron
roster.note: Armor and fusion cannon anchor his profile. The original cartoon form excludes a composite arsenal.

roster.name: Tanjiro Kamado
roster.note: Heightened smell and breathing techniques inform combat. Demon King transformation is outside this profile.

roster.name: Jonathan Joestar
roster.note: Hamon is particularly effective against vampires. Water can conduct Hamon in the original series.

roster.name: Dio Brando
roster.note: The World's time stop and vampire healing are substantial. Direct sunlight remains a source-specific weakness.

open: Direct sunlight severely limits DIO’s ability to stay exposed.

roster.name: Alucard
roster.note: Stored souls and regeneration enable extreme recovery, with different conditions when releasing his restraints.

roster.name: Saitama
roster.version: Manga · Monster Association arc, no time reversal
roster.note: Serious attacks and exceptionally high physical durability are observed. A guaranteed one-hit victory is outside the model.

roster.name: Monkey D. Luffy
roster.note: Gear Five expands flexibility and terrain effects. Seawater immersion can severely impede Devil Fruit users.

coast: Shallow water is an immersion risk for a Devil Fruit user. Dry ground remains available.

roster.name: Vegeta
roster.note: Ultra Ego rewards aggression, while accumulated damage still matters. Use the manga form consistently.

roster.name: Pikachu
roster.note: This is Ash's partner at the end of Journeys. Trainer assistance and game-only moves are excluded.

coast: Nearby water can conduct electricity, with no guarantee of a clean hit.

roster.name: Charizard
roster.note: Flight and fire attacks define the kit. Mega Evolution or a trainer's item are separate conditions.

coast: Surf and wet footing restrict sustained ground movement.

roster.name: Mewtwo
roster.note: Psychic offense and recovery are available in this game-based profile. Mega forms are separate.

roster.name: Link
roster.version: Breath of the Wild · Master Sword and regular gear
roster.note: Archery, shield use, runes and standard equipment give Link a varied toolkit. External assistance is excluded.

roster.name: Samus Aran
roster.version: Metroid Dread · late-game regular suit kit
roster.note: Suit mobility and layered weapon systems support fights at range. One-off ending transformations are excluded.

inland: Enclosed tunnels suit the Morph Ball and close-range equipment.

roster.name: Scorpion
roster.note: Chain spear, hellfire and teleportation define Hanzo's attack options. The newer timeline's Scorpion is separate.

roster.name: Batman
roster.version: Bruce Wayne · standard gear, zero prep
roster.note: Prepared countermeasures and special armor are excluded. Cover favors stealth and ordinary gadgets.

urban: Buildings provide anchor points for the grappling gear.

roster.name: Aquaman
roster.note: Swimming and aquatic abilities become more relevant near water. No armies, outside allies or summons are assumed.

coast: Water access makes it easier to use his own aquatic maneuvering to deliver force.

roster.name: Wonder Woman
roster.note: Enhanced physical ability and extensive combat training combine with bracers and lasso. Complicated crossover interactions are uncertain.

roster.name: The Flash
roster.note: The Speed Force anchors movement and reaction estimates. Time-travel rewrites and exceptional crossovers are excluded.

roster.name: Heracles
roster.note: Physical strength and the labors are the comparison baseline. Divine apotheosis is outside this version.

roster.name: Achilles
roster.note: Uses the Iliad warrior and armor, excluding later invulnerability traditions.

roster.name: Odysseus
roster.note: Expert deception and archery shape this profile. Divine assistance is outside the one-on-one scenario.

roster.name: Yugi Muto
roster.version: Duel Monsters · Yugi Muto, no physical summon rule
roster.note: Duel strategy is strong, but card mechanics are distinct from physical attacks. Atem and unrestricted divine summons need separate profiles.

roster.name: Magikarp
roster.note: Low-end combat reference for this roster. A weak attack kit does not turn it into a canonical zero in every setting.
